sloka: कदा विक्षोभ्य रक्षाम्सि सा विधूय उत्पतिष्यति ।राक्षसीमध्यगा शेते स्नुषा दशरथस्य च ॥६-५-१६॥।।
transliteration: kadā vikṣobhya rakṣāmsi sā vidhūya utpatiṣyati ।rākṣasīmadhyagā śete snuṣā daśarathasya ca ॥6-5-16॥।।

translations.english: My beloved is king Janaka's daughter and daughterinlaw of Dasaratha. Yet she is sleeping amid Rakshasas. How is it?
